races.paceDynamic: Suddenly I See and Thestral will engage from the off as the two confirmed front runners, with Saxon Prince, Mayaada, Ibn Altheeb, Parole Officer, Attention Seeker and Just A Gambler all likely to race prominently behind them. This sets up a solid gallop over the mile trip with genuine pace pressure throughout. The hold-up horses Alkumatic Jo Jo, Keep An Eye On It, Supreme Clarets, Blues And Royals and Kameko Fever will need to overcome traffic issues in a field of 13. This honest pace and competitive nature heavily favours prominent racers who can position close to the pace without getting embroiled in the early battle.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Wins
scenarios.trigger: If the two leaders duel early and soften each other up
scenarios.body: Saxon Prince, Mayaada or Ibn Altheeb can track the pace without the pressure and strike late when the leaders weaken. The prominent position gives them first run on the faltering front pair while avoiding traffic problems that will hamper hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one of Suddenly I See or Thestral gets an uncontested lead
scenarios.body: The survivor can dictate fractions and prove tough to peg back despite the competitive nature behind. Suddenly I See's 211-day break is a concern but both have shown they can lead successfully when getting their own way.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Hero Charges
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely strong and the field spreads out
scenarios.body: Blues And Royals or Alkumatic Jo Jo can get the perfect setup from the back as the pace collapses. Their class can shine through if they get clear runs in the straight and the leaders have gone too fast early.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders get headed quickly and the race becomes messy
scenarios.body: The whole complexion changes to a sprint finish where any horse with tactical speed can win. This chaotic scenario could see an outsider like Attention Seeker or Parole Officer capitalise on the confusion.

watchPoints.text: Suddenly I See and Thestral must be monitored early - if one gets away alone the race dynamic completely changes
Keep An Eye On It and Blues And Royals need to be handy turning in or they'll struggle to make ground through traffic
Saxon Prince's early positioning crucial - too keen chasing the leaders ruins his winning chance
Supreme Clarets returning after six months needs the pace to be strong enough to bring hold-up horses into play
Ibn Altheeb wearing cheekpieces for first time could show improved enthusiasm from prominent position

races.paceDynamic: Ice Sovereigns, Samra Green, and the reinstated Applesandpears will clash for early supremacy in what promises to be a fierce gallop from the off. With three confirmed front-runners in a 12-runner field, the pace will be genuinely strong throughout, stretching the field and creating opportunities for closers. The stamina-testing nature of this tempo will punish horses that get embroiled in the early battle. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can stay out of trouble early and pick up the pieces when the pace takes its toll.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Collapses Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If all three front-runners go too fast early and fade from 2f out
scenarios.body: The blistering gallop set by Ice Sovereigns, Samra Green and Applesandpears will crack under pressure, leaving them vulnerable to late closers. Hold-up horses like Perfect Part and Jannas Journey can time their runs perfectly to sweep past the tiring pace-setters.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: One Leader Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Ice Sovereigns or Samra Green can break clear and dictate alone
scenarios.body: The winner breaks away from the other front-runners mid-race and controls the tempo, having enough left to resist late challenges. Their tactical advantage of getting first run on the field proves decisive in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Bellarchi or Callianassa can sit just behind the leaders without getting involved
scenarios.body: The prominent horses avoid the early pace battle but stay close enough to pounce when the leaders weaken. Their position allows them to quicken at the crucial moment while the hold-up horses are still making ground from too far back.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Moderate Suits All
scenarios.trigger: If the three front-runners settle into a more manageable rhythm early
scenarios.body: Without the expected pace pressure, the race becomes more tactical and open to all running styles. This scenario reduces the tactical advantage for any particular profile and creates a more conventional finish.

watchPoints.text: Ice Sovereigns, Samra Green and Applesandpears could set unsustainable fractions if all three commit to leading from the start
Perfect Part and Jannas Journey need to be produced with well-timed runs to capitalize on the expected pace collapse
Bellarchi's ability to secure the ideal tracking position behind the leaders without getting caught up in early speed duel
Second Fiddle wearing tongue-tie for first time suggests trainer expects significant improvement from the veteran
Both Burke runners Samra Green and Dunkeld Dreamer returning from breaks but stable in good current form

races.paceDynamic: Thunder Wonder will lead unopposed early, setting a comfortable tempo with no pressure from genuine pace rivals. The congestion comes behind him where Sea Force, Mirsky, Saint Etienne, Sir Paul Ramsey and Dwindling Funds all want prominent positions, creating inevitable traffic problems turning for home. With 7 of 12 runners adopting hold-up tactics, there's a large chasing pack that will be looking for gaps simultaneously in the straight. This tactical setup clearly favours the leader Thunder Wonder and the genuine hold-up horses who can find clear racing room, penalising those caught in the prominent pack squeeze.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Thunder Wonder gets his own way in front and stays on strongly
scenarios.body: The lone leader enjoys perfect fractions while the prominent pack behind scrambles for position, allowing Thunder Wonder to build an unassailable advantage. His recent form figures don't reflect this tactical edge he holds today.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Strike Late
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners get in each other's way turning for home
scenarios.body: The traffic problems materialise as predicted with Sea Force, Mirsky and Saint Etienne all compromised, allowing the patient hold-up horses to sweep through with clear runs. James McHenry and Noche Clasica benefit most from the tactical chaos ahead.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Horse Escapes Trouble
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners gets first run on Thunder Wonder
scenarios.body: Sea Force or Mirsky manages to avoid the traffic and gets first run at the leader, with class telling in the final furlong. The winner comes from those able to race handily without getting trapped.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Thunder Wonder stops quickly and the prominent pack stalls
scenarios.body: The leader hits the wall and the prominent runners are still fighting each other, leaving the race to the deep closers who stayed out of trouble. This requires multiple things to go wrong up front.

watchPoints.text: Watch for Thunder Wonder getting away with soft fractions early - if unopposed he becomes very dangerous despite recent form
Monitor Sea Force, Mirsky, Saint Etienne, Sir Paul Ramsey and Dwindling Funds for traffic problems 2-3 furlongs out when they all need racing room
Check if any of the hold-up horses get too far back early - James McHenry and Noche Clasica need to be within striking distance
Observe Thunder Wonder's jumping from the gates - he needs to assert his lead immediately to control the tempo
Watch for jockey positioning through the first half-mile as the prominent runners jostle for the ideal spot behind Thunder Wonder

races.paceDynamic: L'Eagle Aid will attempt to dictate from the front with Fox Journey, Sixpack and Velvet Whisper tracking closely in the prominent positions. The pace should be sustainable rather than frenetic given only one confirmed front-runner, allowing the large hold-up contingent to stay in touch around the bend. This steady gallop will create a cavalry charge finish as the numerous hold-up horses (Humble Spark, Haveyoumissedme, Made All, Ludo's Landing, Fast Fred, Simple Star, Northwest Passage, Terrorise, Say What You See, Dust Cover) get their chance in the final three furlongs. The controlled tempo and long straight at Musselburgh strongly favours horses that can produce a sustained finish from off the pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Brigade Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If L'Eagle Aid sets steady fractions without serious pressure early
scenarios.body: The large pack of hold-up horses gets the perfect setup to unleash finishing kicks in the home straight. Proven finishers with strong recent form capitalize on the tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Persists
scenarios.trigger: If Fox Journey or Sixpack can track L'Eagle Aid without overexerting
scenarios.body: One of the prominent runners gets first run on the field and holds off the late challengers. Their tactical position proves decisive in a slowly-run affair.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Closer Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is particularly sedate allowing maximum closing sectionals
scenarios.body: A horse from the very back of the field produces the strongest finish having conserved energy. The longest-priced hold-up runners benefit most from crawling fractions.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Steals It
scenarios.trigger: If L'Eagle Aid faces no serious early pressure and gets uncontested lead
scenarios.body: L'Eagle Aid dictates throughout and kicks clear before the hold-up horses can organize their challenge. The lack of pace pressure allows the leader to save enough for home.

watchPoints.text: L'Eagle Aid must be watched early - if facing no pace pressure whatsoever could steal significant advantage before field reacts
Fox Journey returning from 181-day absence needs monitoring for fitness levels despite previous fresh victories
Say What You See dropping from recent higher-grade efforts could find this easier and possesses strong finishing kick
Simple Star's 211-day layoff is major concern despite being three-time course winner with proven finishing ability
Made All seeking hat-trick after recent Thirsk success and Oisin Orr booking suggests stable expects another bold show

races.paceDynamic: Maldevious is the sole confirmed front-runner but faces immediate pressure from five prominent racers (Kelpie Grey, Ziggy's Condor, Benacre, Polygram, Sea Suite) who will create serious congestion in the opening exchanges. This traffic jam will force some prominents to pull back or race wide, while Maldevious may get an easier lead than expected if rivals take each other on. The pace will be genuine but not suicidal, with the real danger coming 2-3 furlongs out when the hold-up horses (Qazaq, Abduction, Cargin Bhui, They All Know Me) launch their challenges through tiring leaders. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can find clear runs and produce strong finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners create early pace pressure and fade
scenarios.body: The congested early pace will set up perfectly for the patient hold-up horses to sweep past tiring leaders. Qazaq, Abduction and Cargin Bhui all have the class and finishing kick to exploit this scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Suits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Maldevious gets pressured early by multiple prominent runners
scenarios.body: The genuine pace will stretch the field and create gaps for late runners to exploit in the final furlong. Sea Suite's recent win shows he can benefit from strong gallops.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Runner Survives Traffic
scenarios.trigger: If one prominent runner avoids the early scrimmaging and gets a good position
scenarios.body: Benacre or Ziggy's Condor could escape the congestion and have enough left to hold off the late challengers. Their recent form suggests they can sustain a strong pace.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Maldevious Wire-To-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners fail to apply serious early pressure
scenarios.body: With a clear lead and no sustained pressure, Maldevious could dictate terms and prove hard to peg back despite his poor recent record. His wind surgery may have addressed previous issues.

watchPoints.text: Watch for severe early congestion as five prominent runners (Kelpie Grey, Ziggy's Condor, Benacre, Polygram, Sea Suite) clash for position behind Maldevious
Monitor Maldevious closely after wind surgery - if he shows improved breathing, he could steal a march on the field
Track Qazaq and Cargin Bhui for clear runs 2f out as both need gaps to deliver their finishing kicks effectively
Note any market support for Polygram returning from 173 days off with trainer Tristan Davidson 0/6 in past 14 days

races.paceDynamic: Right And Exact will lead unopposed early as the sole confirmed front-runner, setting a sustainable tempo over 5f on good ground. The real congestion comes behind with seven runners wanting prominent positions - Blind Beggar, Pop Star, South Parade, Equity Law, Emerald Harmony, Al Hussar, and Kinetic Force - creating a wall of pace that will string out the field. This prominent traffic jam will compromise several runners 2-3f out, leaving the patient hold-up horses with clear runs to exploit. The race shape strongly favours hold-up runners who can navigate the early scramble and finish with clean sweeps.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent pack creates traffic problems and bunches up 2f out
scenarios.body: The patient hold-up brigade get clear runs while the prominent runners compromise each other in a wall of horses. Clean finishing kicks from the back prove decisive over this sharp 5f trip.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pace Sustains
scenarios.trigger: If one or two of the prominent runners can secure good early positions without interference
scenarios.body: The early pace becomes more strung out than bunched, allowing the best prominent runners to dictate and kick clear. Traffic issues are minimized by better early positioning.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Right And Exact Wires Field
scenarios.trigger: If Right And Exact gets an uncontested lead and the prominent pack fails to organize properly
scenarios.body: The leader builds an unassailable advantage while the chasers get in each other's way trying to close the gap. Sustainable pace becomes winning pace over this minimum trip.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Benefits Closer
scenarios.trigger: If Right And Exact sets it up too slowly and the prominent runners also go pedestrian early
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where raw speed matters more than position, suiting horses with high TopSpeed figures. Late pace injection catches a dawdling field.

watchPoints.text: Right And Exact's 222-day absence could see the confirmed leader fade badly in the final furlong despite getting an easy time
The prominent congestion involving seven runners will create a cavalry charge 3f out that could bring down several fancied runners
Northern Spirit and Zarzyni as the main hold-up threats need to avoid getting trapped behind the wall of prominent runners
Pop Star's high TopSpeed rating of 92 could be significant if the pace becomes truly-run
Goldie's three runners (Montezuma, Arnhem, Classy Al) are all hold-up types perfectly positioned for this race shape
